title: OnePlus Announces Buds Pro 4 With AI and Enhanced Audio
excerpt: OnePlus has revealed its new Buds Pro 4 wireless earbuds on its official global website, featuring AI capabilities and improved noise cancellation.
body_html:
OnePlus has officially showcased its upcoming wireless earbuds, the Buds Pro 4, on its global website. The new audio device arrives with several upgrades, including enhanced sound quality.

According to the details provided, the latest model features integrated artificial intelligence capabilities alongside a noise cancellation system that delivers twice the performance of previous iterations.

The company revealed the product quietly online, highlighting the audio improvements and new technological additions built into the hardware.
